blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The positive public satisfaction with House representatives affirms Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III’s efforts to bring the chamber closer to the people by focusing on work and listening to its constituents. Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand “Dinand” Hernandez issued that statement on Monday in reaction to the latest OCTA Research Tugon ng Masa survey, which showed that nearly two in three Filipinos, or 64 percent, believe their district representative had been doing a good job representing their constituency in the House.
